verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that ElevenLabs lets you connect conversational agents to external MCP servers so they can access and process information from those servers. This delivers the core of the story: the voice agent acts as an MCP client using MCP servers as tool sources. The hosted MCP server, which manages agents, is a separate server-side role and is not credited here. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that one MCP connection exposes a server's whole toolset to the agent, documentation of invoking MCP tools live mid-call (only implied by the tools framework), and details on transport, auth or tool approval, plus no independent or hands-on corroboration.
